lessons: She follows through best in the 17:30-19:00 habitual evening window, on weekends, and with physical or outdoor opportunity; intensity 2 tasks were always done, intensity 3 less reliable. Early mornings, midday low self-efficacy, and social or psychological-capability contexts are weaker. Cardio was placed in a dry early evening, the long walk on a Sunday late afternoon, planning tasks in a Sunday physical-opportunity slot, calm tasks in evening slots, and alongside tasks close to related activities.
